summary: A Flydubai Boeing 737 en route Dubai-Tel Aviv sent distress signals, changed course to Saudi airspace, and landed in Saudi Arabia amid reports of a physical cockpit struggle; Israeli, Saudi, and Jordanian fighters scrambled. US completed withdrawal from Iraq as Iraqi resistance vows to retain weapons. UK asserts strong indications of Iran involvement in RAF Fairford incident.
key_points: Flydubai Boeing 737 Dubai-Tel Aviv sent emergency code 7700 then 7500, changed course to Saudi airspace; Israeli fighters scrambled; landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Cockpit struggle reported. (Source: @mamlekate/104710)
US forces complete withdrawal from Iraq; last troops left Erbil air base. Iraqi resistance vows to keep arms after 'painful blows' to US. (Source: @SharghDaily/186786)
UK PM Burnham cites 'strong indications' Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident; 5 UK men arrested then released on bail. Iran FM dismisses claims. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7717)
Intense UAV activity detected over IRGC headquarters in Marand, East Azerbaijan Province, with power outage reported. (Source: @shin_persian/10642)
Gas pipeline supplying Tishreen Thermal Power Plant explodes near Damascus International Airport; second gas pipeline in Syria explodes within two days. (Source: @presstv/209000, @naya_foriraq/92196)
Armed attack on bus in Hama, Syria; casualties reported by official SANA news agency. (Source: @SharghDaily/186796)
UAE grounds all flights to/from Israel; Flydubai suspended 6 days; Israeli rescue flights with enhanced security to operate. (Source: @almogboker78/18337, @amitsegal/65393)

sections.threat_assessment: The Flydubai cockpit incident raises significant aviation security concerns across Gulf-Israel routes, with Saudi and Jordanian military scrambling alongside Israeli jets indicating heightened regional alert. Iran-linked threats to RAF Fairford—a key US logistics hub for potential strikes on Iranian missile sites—combined with UAV activity over IRGC headquarters in Marand suggest asymmetric escalation cycles. Iraqi resistance vows to retain weapons following US withdrawal create a security vacuum risk. Concurrent gas pipeline attacks in Syria and the Hama bus attack indicate ongoing instability in Syrian conflict zones.
sections.regional_response: UAE grounded all flights to/from Israel and suspended Flydubai operations for 6 days; Netanyahu coordinated with UAE President bin Zayed and Trump. Saudi and Jordanian fighters participated in the Flydubai response, signaling coordinated Gulf air defense posture. Iraqi celebrations in Karbala mark US departure while Iraq's presidency simultaneously denies justification for armed factions retaining weapons—contradicting resistance vows to keep arms. Israel's Shin Bet had warned for months about UAE-Israel route vulnerabilities now validated by the incident.
sections.intelligence_notes: Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar warned for months about serious security problems on UAE-Israel flight routes, now corroborated by the Flydubai cockpit incident. IDF Chief of Staff conducted emergency assessment with Air Force commander, Amatz, and Aman. The Flydubai hypothesis of pilot dispute vs. hijacking remains unconfirmed; reports conflict on pilot nationalities (Emirati/Omani). UK released 5 suspects on bail complicating Fairford investigation despite 'strong indications' of Iran involvement. Mossad confirmed crew and approved rescue flight operation.
